# Fever Game Today
> Live WNBA Scores, Caitlin Clark Stats & Indiana Fever Highlights

Fever Game Today is the ultimate fan destination for Indiana Fever basketball. We provide real-time game updates, detailed player statistics, season averages, and curated video analysis.

## Key Content
- **Live Scores**: Real-time updates for all Indiana Fever WNBA games.
- **Caitlin Clark Stats**: Tracking record-breaking three-pointers, assists, and overall impact on the WNBA.
- **Guides**: Comprehensive guides on how to watch Fever games on TV and streaming (Prime Video, ION, WNBA League Pass).
